label: Tax year 2027

rate.sentence: No PSEB registration number is saved, so this estimate uses 1%, the rate for everyone else. If you are registered with PSEB, save your number in Settings, then Tax and PSEB, and the estimate will use 0.25%.

return.sentence: The income tax return for tax year 2027 is due by 30 Sep 2027. FBR has moved this date in past years, so check FBR for the current date.

checklist.text: If you can register with PSEB, registered and certified IT exporters pay 0.25% instead of 1%.
File your income tax return for tax year 2027. The tax your bank took is a final tax only if you file.
File your withholding tax statements if you are required to.
File your sales tax returns if you are required to. PSEB-registered IT exporters do not need them for this purpose.
Ask your bank for the tax it took from each foreign payment and compare it with this estimate.

not_covered: Tax on payments from clients inside Pakistan.
Whether to choose not to be taxed this way for a year.
Any older tax credit for IT exporters (section 65F). We could not confirm whether it still applies.
Advance tax paid in instalments during the year.
Sales tax on services, which the provinces collect.
Income from salary, property, investments or the sale of assets.
The tax your bank actually took. Only your bank's records show that.
notes: These figures are estimates built from the payments you recorded in LanceraOS. Your bank's own records show the tax it actually took.
A payment in a currency other than PKR is treated as money earned from outside Pakistan. A payment in PKR is treated as a local payment, and no bank deduction is estimated for it.
The estimate applies one rate, the one for your PSEB status today, to every payment in the tax year, including payments from before your PSEB registration.

The bank takes the tax when the money reaches your bank account in Pakistan. LanceraOS uses the date you recorded for each payment, so money that stayed in a Payoneer or Wise balance for a while may be taxed in a later month.
This tax year is not over. The figures cover 01 Jul 2026 to 10 Nov 2026.
